subject: Request: trial runway top-up — build sync lag
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@shoploom.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extra trial runway — CI sync lag blocking POC

Hi Laura / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding — the Redwood runtime looks promising. We hit a blocker in our integration sprint that is preventing us from completing the POC validation: our CI deployment reproduces tokenization mismatches when we load the model via the current adapter. Engineering traced it to an async config mismatch that will take ~10 business days to patch and verify across environments.

We’re mid-demo window and need a short runway so we can finish integration validation without losing momentum. Can you help with either a 2-week trial extension or a one-off sandbox credit top-up (we estimate ~$600 — our current sandbox was consumed running load tests)? I attached the integration logs we referenced.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call if that helps. Appreciate any flexibility here — we’re close to an internal pilot decision.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Head of Platform Engineering
ShopLoom

Attachments: integration_logs_20260819.zip
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@shoploom.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extra trial runway — CI sync lag blocking POC

Hi Ellen — thanks for the detail and for sharing the logs. Sorry to hear about the deployment mismatch — that sort of timing issue is unfortunately common across adapters.

Quick questions so I can scope this internally:
- Can you confirm the estimated extra runtime (tokens/hours) you expect over the next 2 weeks?
- Is the failure reproducible on a lower concurrency run (so we can suggest a short-term config change)?
- Do you have a target date for the verified fix?

I’ve looped Ben (growth) and Marissa (finance/program ops) so we can evaluate a short credit top-up + 2-week extension. I’ll follow up internally and get back within 24 business hours. If you’re available, I can set a 20-min call tomorrow at 9:30am PT to walk through the logs together.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Lead — Strategic
Redwood Inference

> Hi Laura / Marissa,
> 
> Thanks again for the quick onboarding — the Redwood runtime looks promising...
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Request: extra trial runway — ShopLoom POC (logs attached)

Team — forwarding ShopLoom’s note. TL;DR: integration bug will take ~10 business days to remediate; they need runway to finish the POC and keep momentum. Attached are the logs Ellen shared.

Proposal: approve a one-off sandbox credit top-up of $600 and a 14-calendar-day trial extension (from their current expiry) conditional on the following:
- Ellen confirms the fix target date and a short daily test plan to validate once patched.
- We tag the spend to deal SL-448 and set a soft cap so finance is aware.
- Sales provides a short summary to include in renewal/expansion conversation.

Rationale: ShopLoom is a mid-market merchant with strong usage signals during trial and real pilot potential. Preserving demo momentum reduces churn risk and helps close a higher-value committed job later.

Questions for approvers:
- Ben: OK to approve $600 credit (one-off promotional top-up) from growth budget?
- Marissa: Finance ops — do we need a PO/SOW to attach to the credit, or can we apply against the trial without procurement?
- Rishi / Dev: any security or EULA considerations if we extend sandbox access for another 2 weeks?

I’ll stand by for approvals and will then confirm with Ellen.

Thanks,
Laura

Attachments: integration_logs_20260819.zip
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Request: extra trial runway — ShopLoom POC (logs attached)

Laura — good catch and reasonable ask. Approve $600 promotional sandbox top-up and a 14-day extension. Please apply the following controls:
- Tag promo credit to deal SL-448 and mark as \"trial-promo-aug26\" in billing metadata.
- Soft cap of $750 with email alert to me and Marissa if usage approaches cap.
- Include a one-paragraph note in HubSpot describing the integration blocker and the agreed extension.

Marissa — if you can confirm there’s no procurement required for a one-off promotional credit, we’re clear. If procurement is required at your end, let me know and we’ll route through SR-credits.

Rishi — from a security perspective I don’t anticipate any change in scope; we’re not adding new connectors. If you want to run a quick sanity check on the logs, happy to wait until you sign off.

Ben
Growth Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@shoploom.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extra trial runway — CI sync lag blocking POC

Hi Ellen — good news: we approved a one-time sandbox credit top-up of $600 and a 14-calendar-day extension to your trial window. Ben requested we tag the credit to SL-448 and apply a soft cap/alert at $750.

Next steps:
- I attached a short SOW draft (SOW_draft_shoploom_v1.docx) that describes the extension and credit terms — please review and reply if anything looks off.
- Confirm the fix target date (you mentioned ~10 business days) and paste the test plan so we can document it in the deal notes.
- I’ll add a HubSpot note and tag the promo as \"trial-promo-aug26\".

If you’d like, we can do the 20-min troubleshooting call tomorrow at 9:30am PT to walk the logs with our infra engineer (Dev).

Thanks for the quick turnaround — we’re excited to keep this moving.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Lead — Strategic
Redwood Inference
